description: Deliver a reply as though the recipient sent it. SANDBOX KEYS ONLY — refused on live keys, because it would write words a real person never said into their transcript and consent record. This is how you exercise a conversation end to end without touching a phone.

optionIndex.description: A reply chip on the NEWEST message, 1-based. Arrives as a real postback.

postbackData.description: A chip from ANY recent message, by the slug we generated when we sent it (label lowercased, non-alphanumerics to underscores, then _ and its 1-based position among all chips on that message — e.g. "skip_today_2"). This is how you rehearse a LATE TAP: someone reads the morning message and answers after the next one has gone out. `optionIndex` cannot express that, and a late tap behaves differently enough to be worth its own test. An unknown slug comes back with the ones we do know.

text.description: What they typed, e.g. "182.4" or "STOP" or "START"

name: cadence_simulate_reply
